Let's go through our continuity checklist:

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14040492/assets/29d8d36954a25bff5808ce7c59dfc3ec0e373d22541cc2df85c93aa0a74c8bb4.png) exists ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14040492/assets/a4785336954b0736113ea8ad968aa60db31e55720ff5bdeb128597a8c7c72b90.png)

- Let's now check the left and right limits. We see that
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14040492/assets/949d5bef0569fbd6f58382e07873412bb07cf3b735ae264c9cb78b366fa59bd2.png)
while
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14040492/assets/d6dfbdbb30c840068ad7a86370f6e444453f925ba8869140b7288b51d164f228.png)
So both the left and right limits exist and are finite, but they are not equal. ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14040492/assets/81510388d37345ec3bfb525da6795c62d4ef190798e1574139469b5a90d17d69.png)
